chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad, from al-Barqi, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Revealing the navel, the thigh, and the knee in the mosque is from the awrah (parts of the body that must be covered)."
ai.seo_question: What parts of the body are considered 'awrah if exposed in the mosque according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) specifies the boundaries of modesty within the mosque, identifying the navel, thigh, and knee as part of the 'awrah that should not be exposed during prayer or residence. This ruling aligns with the broader Shia jurisprudential emphasis on maintaining physical dignity and reverence in sacred spaces, distinguishing the mosque's sanctity from general public areas. It serves as a practical guideline for worshippers to ensure their attire meets the spiritual standards of the house of Allah.
